title: Choose an OSI license and contribution/trademark policy
acceptance: Record license tradeoff and approved SPDX license; add LICENSE and contribution terms after approval.
No third-party code merged before the license decision.

title: Validate licensed search provider for indexed Reddit evidence
acceptance: Compare approved search APIs for indexed Reddit URLs, coverage, quotas, cost and Workers/Node compatibility.
Document compliant links/snippets/cache retention and test exact-domain identity matching with synthetic cases.
Do not implement unauthorized scraping or claim full Reddit coverage.

title: Validate Google Places access and exact-business identity mapping
acceptance: Verify API credentials, billing, attribution and storage/display terms for rating and review count.
Document exact-store matching, no-match and ambiguous-match cases; test a bounded sample with approved access.
Record provider rate limits and both deployment configurations.

title: Create adjudicated evaluation dataset and measurement protocol
acceptance: Define risky labels, independent review process, sampling and uncertainty reporting; use permitted data/synthetic fixtures.
Specify launch gates: >=80% risky Caution/High and <=5% false High among High outputs.
Ensure benign new stores, ambiguous business names, reposts and malicious content are represented.

title: Approve threat, privacy, and public-claims operating policy
acceptance: Document privacy/retention, anonymous identity limits, SSRF and prompt-injection controls, correction SLA and evidence-validation gate.
Define public High concern language and appeal path; review source-attribution and US-English scope.
No public launch on unreviewed draft policy.

title: Scaffold TypeScript monorepo and dual-runtime test harness
acceptance: Choose package manager/runtime versions and workspace layout for apps and packages in one repository.
Create runnable Wrangler-local and Node/SQLite smoke tests with shared fixtures and locked dependencies.
Document exact commands; do not provision production resources.

title: Define versioned domain identity, evidence, coverage and assessment contracts
acceptance: Define runtime-validated /v1 schemas for store identity, coverage, evidence and assessment with explicit limited/no-match/failed states.
Test hosted tenant subdomain separation, URL normalization and backwards-compatible serialization.
Core imports no Node/Cloudflare provider SDKs.

title: Implement portable persistence and migration adapters
acceptance: Same schema semantics verified on D1 and local SQLite; tested migration up/down or safe forward recovery.
Persist dated evidence references, jobs, corrections and account-separated private analysis without storing full review corpora.
Include retention/deletion tests and no production IDs/secrets.

title: Implement atomic job admission, cache freshness and quotas
acceptance: One new investigation/store/min globally with concurrent join and crash-safe retry; week-long freshness and owner/admin early refresh path.
Enforce 5 new jobs/min/user, 30 cached reads/min/user, separate status/AI quotas and anonymous abuse backstop.
Race tests on both runtimes; no D1 read-then-write assumption.

title: Implement versioned check/status/store API
acceptance: POST /v1/checks and GET /v1/checks/{id} return cached/checking/complete/rate-limited/unsupported with retry-after.
Normalize origins, validate public fetch destinations, redirects and body bounds; never forward shopper cookies.
Contract tests in Wrangler local and Node with no external credentials.

title: Add CI, fixtures, dependency and cross-runtime gates
acceptance: CI runs formatting, lint, strict typecheck, unit/integration tests, dual-runtime smoke, build and audit.
Synthetic fixtures cover identity confusion, outage vs no-match, low-review-count, duplicate jobs and malicious source text.
Document required check names before enforcing branch protection.

title: Build approved indexed-Reddit search connector
acceptance: Use operator-configured approved search provider; return direct indexed Reddit URLs with timestamps and source metadata.
Only exact domain/corroborated store identity affects rating; deduplicate reposts; no complete-coverage claims.
Fixtures for missing results, provider outage, quota and malicious snippets on both runtimes.

title: Build Google Business Profile connector and match validator
acceptance: Use configured Places API; exact-entity match with documented rationale and explicit ambiguity/no-match.
Return linked rating, review count and observed date with required attribution; no full review corpus persisted.
Test similarly named businesses and below-3.0/20-review boundary.

title: Implement verified business identity and operating-history evidence
acceptance: Document and test actually verifying directories/providers with store-to-identity link and >=1 year independent operation.
Do not equate domain age, HTTPS, policy pages or payment logos with verified business identity.
Return missing/ambiguous provenance as no match or limited evidence.

title: Implement concern policy, provenance and public evidence gate
acceptance: Distinguish Caution limited-history vs negative-evidence; no reviews alone never proof of fraud.
One credible Reddit complaint can support Caution; High requires corroboration except exact matched Google rating <3.0 with >=20 reviews, always validated.
All public High concern outputs carry attributable, dated, independent sources and pass gate; failure downgrades with explicit reason.

title: Ship click-to-check Chrome/Chromium MV3 extension
acceptance: Explicit click only; send normalized store origin, no screenshots/full HTML or passive browsing collection.
Display cached/checking/limited/caution/high/insufficient, sources, confidence and last checked.
Extension points to hosted or self-hosted API; permission/privacy and browser smoke tests.

title: Build public noindex store result pages
acceptance: Shareable dated evidence/coverage pages, noindex at launch, accessible UI and cautious non-defamatory copy.
Cached result and in-progress state accurate; no personal check history.
Verify noindex header/meta, source links, no-match disclosure, accessibility and correction link.

title: Implement domain ownership verification and early refresh
acceptance: Verify DNS TXT or site-file proof bound to exact store identity and tenant subdomain.
Only verified owner/admin may refresh before weekly expiry, still respecting global cooldown; ownership never changes concern.
Audit proof/expiry/revocation and reject same-name impersonation.

title: Implement disputes, human review and public correction notices
acceptance: Any reader can report a factual issue; credible High concern dispute flags page for human review while dated finding remains.
Moderation records decision; public correction notices show factual changes, routine reassessments not exposed.
No store owner can delete or self-edit verdict.

title: Implement provider-pluggable private BYOK analysis
acceptance: Capability-based AI interface, structured output with evidence IDs and prompt-injection defenses; non-AI result stays functional and marked limited.
BYOK key encrypted server-side, deletable, redacted in logs and isolated by account; BYOK result private and cannot mutate public verdict.
Test at least two provider adapters with fixtures; local-only models unavailable to Workers are documented.

title: Implement managed AI allowance, metering and public validation
acceptance: Logged-in request only; small free allowance and paid usage design with independent AI quota and no anonymous managed AI spend.
Managed AI proposal may update public result only after identity, citations and publication gate succeed.
Provide billing/abuse tests and explicit fail-closed behavior; do not enable paid usage without approval.

title: Package and verify Cloudflare Workers deployment
acceptance: Document Wrangler/D1/Queues/secrets setup and reproducible local bootstrap; no hardcoded live IDs.
Verify API, worker, public page and dispute flow against actual Worker local runtime.
Live provisioning and external provider smoke require separately approved credentials.

title: Package and verify conventional self-hosted deployment
acceptance: Document Node/SQLite durable jobs, backups/migrations, secret configuration and container deployment.
Same API/public/owner/dispute acceptance suite as Cloudflare; startup refuses absent search/Places config.
Provide bootstrap fixture, health/readiness and upgrade/rollback instructions.

title: Run independent launch evaluation and security/privacy review
acceptance: Measure thresholds on independent labeled dataset and publish sample size, false-High precision, risky detection and uncertainty.
Test concurrent limits, SSRF, tenant isolation, correction response, public noindex and provider terms in both deployments.
Block public launch when gates or licensing unresolved; no unverified performance claim.

title: Research product/image match and alternative-vendor phase
acceptance: Design licensed image/product search and gold set for same-product vs same-photo false matches.
Recommendations require delivered price, variant match and documented protections; no paid placement in safety ranking.
No v1 screenshot, evasion or product comparison implementation.

title: Plan Firefox, broader markets and anti-evasion after v1
acceptance: Document permission and API differences, language/local data licensing, and evidence for bot-evasion work.
Keep separate from v1 launch scope; no speculative crawler bypass.
